acceptance.observable: Detection. A non-empty PreToolUse in an installed plugin's hooks/hooks.json is an ISSUE when %LOCALAPPDATA%\cursor-agent exists. The message names the plugin, the version, the matchers, T-046 and the remedy. The registry and hooks.json are parsed, not pattern-matched. "PreToolUse" appearing in a description or another matcher is not a finding.

Skip is not pass. No registry, an unreadable or malformed registry or hooks.json, or no Cursor CLI: each is a SKIP or an ISSUE that says why, never a PASS. Look for an input that yields PASS without the check having looked: a missing installPath, a plugin listed with zero installs, hooks.json absent, or a non-Windows host with no LOCALAPPDATA.
Fixture isolation (G-044). Tests use a fixture home and never read the real profile or inherited process.env silently.
The real machine. Run /sync (read-only, --check if available) on the QA machine and quote the cursor-hook-compat line. Say whether it matches the real plugin cache there.
Preserve. Every other /sync check's result is unchanged, and the check is registered in runSync once.
Your own mutants, at least two, on qa/t046-detector-mut-.
